_help: Act 3, the quiet coast road (coast -> continue, event coast_road): no ambush; a companion remarks on it. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: Five days of salt wind and the trucks grinding along the coast road. Nobody's shot at us. It feels too easy.

r_naguib.speaker: naguib
r_naguib.line: The loads are holding. My men have not had a road this kind in years. Enjoy it. The desert will make up for it.

r_farid.speaker: farid
r_farid.line: We are on time and under budget. If you ever need a partner in the trucking business, remember Farid Mansour.

r_youssef.speaker: youssef
r_youssef.line: So slow! On a horse we would be there already. But, yes, also dead, maybe.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: Quiet road. I don't trust quiet roads. I've doubled the watch.
